message: You know that feeling when you’re the only one in the group with a fire extinguisher in your kitchen? I used to think I was just being gloriously over-prepared, but the other day, I used it to put out a small grease fire while everyone else stood frozen in surprise. Turns out, a little preparedness goes a long way—especially when it comes to kitchen safety. Who else has a secret stash of safety gear that might seem excessive but feels just right?
